overview: Abyssal Drop is the deepest cavern in The Deep, a vertical descent into void fractures and resonance winds leading toward Vex Thal.
history: The Shissar carved the upper layers while fleeing their own bio-arcana experiments.
Thought Horrors expanded the tunnels downward, following psychic resonance.
Void fractures opened after planar instability increased across Luclin.
Abyssal aberrations emerged from the deepest fractures.
Vex Thal resonance currents began flowing upward through the pit.
hooks: A new void fracture opens deeper than any previously recorded.
Abyssal aberrations swarm toward the upper caverns.
Shissar remnants attempt to stabilize an arcane scar.
A resonance surge reveals a hidden Vex Thal passage.
